data.body:
[P2] Enforce the size limit after best-effort truncation

`Truncation.truncateRecord` never removes the execution error and can return an oversized record. For example, an execution-error message containing 127,000 backslashes fits the default raw-record budget, but wrapping it produces over 508,000 bytes. Dropping operations/input/output cannot make that error fit, and this return prints it without another size check. Check the final UTF-8 size and provide a bounded fallback for retained error data, or explicitly fail the export when it cannot fit. Add coverage using an oversized execution error; the new tests only exercise removable input.
